verdict.rationale: Fastmail's Filters & Rules feature lets users define rule-based automations (e.g., move/tag/forward on incoming mail conditions), which satisfies a basic version of 'rules trigger actions on events.' However, this is a traditional email-filter system, not framed for AI-native/agentic use, and there's no evidence of programmatic rule creation via API/JMAP, webhook-triggered actions, or AI-specific automation hooks beyond generic push/EventSource notifications. Missing for 10: API-driven rule creation/management, AI-agent-specific triggers or actions, and richer automation beyond mail filtering.
